tools.purpose: CPU-compatible build-phase mock calculations and indeterminate synthetic orchestration.
tools.validation_scope: synthetic fixtures only; no clinical validation
limitations: Does not segment real echo images

tools.purpose: Local DICOM inventory, JPEG Lossless media decoding, ultrasound-region modality classification, and calibrated CWD/PWD spectral trace extraction for view-classifier validation.
tools.input_contract: A de-identified echo case folder containing DICOM US/SR/PR objects and sidecar files.
tools.output_contract: runs/view_classifier_validation/<case_id> JSON artifacts plus derived local media and spectral trace artifacts.
tools.validation_scope: Focused unit tests and A1-A5 local validation workflow; no clinical validation claimed.
limitations: View labels use ranked metadata, DICOM region, visual-feature, and acquisition-order evidence and require independent review.
PWD sample-site interpretation is not converted to severity without explicit site evidence.
PHI-risk DICOM tag values and private values are redacted from JSON outputs.

tools.purpose: Local evidence-generation and agent-result validation workflow for agentic view classification, with DICOM metadata extraction, rendered media evidence, guideline summaries, Codex specialist task prompts, and preserved PWD/CWD spectral extraction.
tools.input_contract: A de-identified echo case folder containing DICOM US/SR/PR objects and sidecar files.
tools.output_contract: runs/agentic_view_classifier_validation/<case_id> JSON artifacts plus derived local media and spectral trace artifacts.
tools.validation_scope: Focused unit tests and local A1-A5 validation workflow; no clinical validation claimed.
limitations: Python evidence tools do not choose view, modality, or zoom status; Codex specialist agents author classification records.
PWD sample-site interpretation is not converted to severity without explicit site evidence.
PHI-risk DICOM tag values and private values are redacted from JSON outputs.
Guideline summaries are local agent-usable extracts and do not replace full guideline review.
